input.command:
S=/private/tmp/claude-502/-Users-vitaliy-Documents-GitHub-local-whisper/881e21dc-c26e-4f4f-865e-0d78e8553961/scratchpad
run() { local label="$1"; shift; /usr/local/bin/ffmpeg -y -hide_banner "$@" > "$S/$label.log" 2>&1 & local p=$!; sleep 10; kill -INT $p 2>/dev/null; wait $p 2>/dev/null; }
chk() { printf "   %s: samples=" "$1"; /usr/local/bin/ffprobe -v error -show_entries format=duration -of csv=p=0 "$S/$1.wav" 2>/dev/null | tr -d '\n'; printf "s  ffmpeg_timeline="; grep -o "time=[0-9:.]*" "$S/$1.log" | tail -1; }
echo "### E: -thread_queue_size 4096 ###"; run E -thread_queue_size 4096 -f avfoundation -i :default -ac 1 -ar 16000 "$S/E.wav"; chk E
echo "### F: -use_wallclock_as_timestamps 1 ###"; run F -f avfoundation -use_wallclock_as_timestamps 1 -i :default -ac 1 -ar 16000 "$S/F.wav"; chk F
echo "### G: explicit device index :0 ###"; run G -f avfoundation -i ":0" -ac 1 -ar 16000 "$S/G.wav"; chk G
echo "### avfoundation options in this build ###"; /usr/local/bin/ffmpeg -hide_banner -h demuxer=avfoundation 2>&1 | sed -n '1,40p'
echo "### alternatives installed? ###"; which sox rec parec 2>/dev/null; ls -la /usr/local/bin/ffmpeg; /usr/local/bin/ffmpeg -version 2>&1 | head -2
input.description: Test thread_queue_size and other capture fixes
